limits.scope: Three reused FFHQ images x SR4/Motion, original FFHQ pixel DDPM prior. Initial transfer stage only; no new datasets/checkpoints.
limits.baseline: Official pinned DAPS/PFODE/MCMC/VPPrecond/DDPM/operator AST and unmodified Euler torchdiffeq0.2.5; config commands/pixel_ffhq.sh. Batch1 and fixed existing image panel, not author benchmark mean.
limits.grids: 200 annealing outer steps;5 Euler network calls/outer=1000F;100 Langevin updates/outer=20000 measurement gradients. Gaussian prior needs no additional NN.
limits.parameters: Original pixel tau=.01 (not measurement sigma=.05); lr SR1e-4/Motion5e-5, lr_min_ratio=.01. Anneal sigma100/min.1, diffusion min.01, poly7; no tuning.
limits.observations: NEW y from official operators on model[-1,1] sigma=.05; SR uses original antialiased Resizer, Motion61/intensity.5 reflection convolution and seeded original kernel constructor. Shared given y/operator state per pair; not old zero/circular y.
limits.insertion: Only original operator gradient/data drift scaled. q=-lr*gradient(loss)/tau^2 in clean x coordinates, r=y-Hx, d=Hq. Same A71 select; no alpha conversion, extra NN, VJP or finite differences.
limits.preserved: Original prior score, xt term, lr schedule, Langevin random term, annealing re-noising and returned xt retained. Positive global data-drift amplitude can be canceled by projection.
limits.gradient_cost: Original measurement gradients counted separately; no UNet input derivative. Candidate reuses original measurement prediction and adds ONE Hq per MCMC update; RNG untouched.
limits.failure: Native NaN zero-output fallback is rejected as a failed run, never accepted as reconstructed quality. No automatic failed-case rerun or policy fallback.
limits.timing: Same-session complete1000 includes y/operator-state load, original operator construction, init/PFODE/MCMC/re-noising/CPU sync and progress. Model load/probe/measurement generation/metrics/writes separate.
limits.limits: State-dependent likelihood drift changes the MCMC target; no inherited exact-posterior theorem. Small reused development panel; no universal improvement/state-necessity claim.
limits.decision: Mean PSNR>=+.1dB, >=2/3 PSNR wins, SSIM nondecrease and LPIPS nonincrease per task, paired init/final RNG and NN-call fingerprints equal. No hyperparameter scan.
